build_vlm_rcnn_model: build a VLMRCNN meta-arch model from a Detectron2 config for vision-language object detection
run_vlm_rcnn_forward: run the VLMRCNN forward pass to compute training losses on a batch of images and ground truth instances
run_vlm_rcnn_inference: run the VLMRCNN inference pass to detect objects and return postprocessed instances with boxes and scores
convert_proposals_to_instances: convert proposal generator outputs to Instances objects with filtered boxes, scores, and NMS applied
postprocess_detector_results: postprocess detector or proposal Instances by rescaling boxes and masks to original image dimensions
